import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'survived': [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    'pclass': [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],
    'sex': ['male', 'female', 'female', 'female', 'male'],
    'age': [22.0, 38.0, 26.0, 35.0, 35.0],
    'sibsp': [1, 1, 0, 1, 0],
    'parch': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'fare': [7.25, 71.2833, 7.925, 53.1, 8.05],
    'embarked': ['S', 'C', 'S', 'S', 'S'],
    'class': ['Third', 'First', 'Third', 'First', 'Third'],
    'who': ['man', 'woman', 'woman', 'woman', 'man'],
    'adult_male': [True, False, False, False, True],
    'deck': ['', 'C', '', 'C', ''],
    'embark_town': ['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Southampton', 'Southampton', 'Southampton'],
    'alive': ['no', 'yes', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'],
    'alone': [False, False, True, False, True]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set up the visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival by class and gender
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_pivot = df.pivot_table(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived', aggfunc='mean')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax1.legend(title='Gender')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
for survived_status in [0, 1]:
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived_status]
    label = 'Survived' if survived_status == 1 else 'Did Not Survive'
    color = 'green' if survived_status == 1 else 'red'
    ax2.hist(subset['age'].dropna(), alpha=0.5, label=label, color=color, bins=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Fare distribution by class
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
class_order = ['First', 'Third']
boxplot_data = [df[df['class'] == cls]['fare'].dropna() for cls in class_order]
bp = ax3.boxplot(boxplot_data, labels=class_order, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['lightblue', 'lightcoral']
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax3.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class')
ax3.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax3.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')

# 4. Survival count by embarkation town
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'alive']).size().unstack()
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['red', 'green'])
ax4.set_title('Survival Count by Embarkation Town')
ax4.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count')
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# 5. Family size vs survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
ax5.bar(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, color='steelblue')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numerical_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
im = ax6.imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
ax6.set_yticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45)
ax6.set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap')

# Add colorbar to heatmap
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax6, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient')

# Add correlation values to heatmap
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = ax6.text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                       ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
